The selection config is the input, so this decision is attached to the sample it makes. A cell with fewer than 3 galaxies takes the moments of the smallest square of cells centred on it that holds 3. On the image-simulation grids, one cell of two galaxies without this pooling inflated one grid's error on m2 fivefold.","tags":[]},{"ref":"catalogue.decisions.response_estimator","options":[{"id":"separate_normalisation","label":"R_shear + R_selection, each branch on its own weight sum","tags":[],"insights":["catalogue.prior_insights.metacal_response","catalogue.prior_insights.metacal_selection"]},{"id":"joint","label":"Each sheared branch's own ellipticity under its own selection","description":"Agrees with the chosen R to 0.03% on v2.0.0; kept as a diagnostic.","tags":[],"insights":[]},{"id":"common_denominator","label":"One weight sum for both sheared branches","description":"Drops the term from the change of the weight sum under shear.","tags":[],"insights":[]},{"id":"ivw_shear_unweighted_selection","label":"Inverse-variance R_shear with unweighted R_selection","description":"The earlier sp_validation practice; it calibrates a mean other than the weighted mean applied to the catalogue.","tags":[],"insights":[]}],"label":"Response of the weighted mean shear","rationale":"The catalogue's shear estimate is a weighted mean ⟨e⟩ = Σ w e / Σ w over a selection, and R calibrates it.
